name: speccy
description: An elegant OpenAPI reference renderer for the web, macOS, and Docusaurus.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @speccy/renderer && npm run build -w @speccy/docusaurus && npm run build -w @speccy/web && npm run build -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo
scripts.test: npm run test -w @speccy/renderer && npm run test -w @speccy/docusaurus && npm run test -w @speccy/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @speccy/renderer && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/docusaurus && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/web && npm run typecheck -w @speccy/docusaurus-demo
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
